rules.statement: Book plays have types corresponding to player four ordered PlayType slots; same-type plays in the team book may be randomly or specifically called.
Player reports no fixed position restriction for play eligibility; a loaded matching PlayType allows same-type book plays to be called.
Ordered player PlayType slots substantially affect priority; slots 1 and 2 are frequently executed. Exact weighting and selection/fallback algorithm unknown.
Player describes book entries as real basketball plays; this does not certify each name, action branch or actor mapping.
A play can occur under several type categories. Resolve category then play; type mismatch cannot load. Same display name alone must not merge distinct native identifiers.

Slots 1/2 provide most automatic calls, slots 3/4 are occasional. Poor success may gradually encourage other types; many factors including coach affect this. Player frequency description is not a per-game quota or numeric probability.

Specified calls are player button input. CPU-vs-CPU selects automatically; player four types, team offensive configurations, coach system and offensive/defensive focus are related influences without exact measured interactions.

not_inferred: Numerical slot weights or per-game quotas
Same display name implies same native identifier
Manual calling can be commanded by a pregame GM intent
player_confirmed_calling_rules.B2_implication: Interpret existing settings with multi-type eligible-play membership and ordered primary/reserve player types; preserve qualitative influence/uncertainty. No fixed actor prerequisite, precise AI model, new manual-call executor, or new implementation authorized.
